review_notes: Independently read all eight proposed facts' canonical citation ranges and every handoff contradiction evidence range. Proposal and functionality agree: 40 conditional material candidates, retained joint binding, separate Mato objectives, exact damage feedback, and conservative numeric/removal semantics. Supported inherited retained knowledge is preserved; acceptance is scoped to changes and examined contradictions, not a fresh audit of every retained row.
unresolved: Accept nine section-fact and two section-link deferrals: source does not establish compiled .data/.sdata2 allocation, pool extent, ordering or exclusivity.
Accept continued uncertainty for DynamicsDesc selector domain, numeric animation/state meanings, exact removal timing and joint ownership.

proposed_facts.reason: The local callback is registered through the generic material constructor and invoked by its damage-received dispatcher. Separate Mato creation supports replacing the misleading Target qualifier with Material.
Canonical callback operations match the proposed purpose, including hidden hierarchy, effect 0x445, QuakeKind_Small, argument 310 and material-handler delegation.
Dispatcher arguments, consumption of only the item, stored-joint world-position derivation and outgoing calls are verified. Deferring exact removal timing is appropriate.
Generic item construction and the separate shared Mato creation/count path establish the scenery/objective distinction. The local callback has no direct objective-count update.
Object 2 invokes this helper. The table contains 40 candidates before -1, creation has resolution and allocation guards, and the configuration wrapper writes the stated capsule endpoints and scale.

Lookup returns a nullable HSD_JObj pointer. The constructor retains joint, Ground and callbacks; physics subsequently reads the joint. Missing-input and allocation failures return NULL. The final wrapper sets xD0C to 0 and calls it_802714C0 without proving a broader numeric-state interpretation.
The exact candidate count and conditional creation are verified independently. Constructor identity, rather than count alone, distinguishes these material proxies from Mato objectives.

Shared initialization, direct callback-row indexing, synchronous object initialization, persistent joint binding, damage dispatch and separate objective setup agree with the translation-unit summary and functionality document.

contradictions.reason: Accept the five .data fact deferrals and .data link deferral. Source supports the course descriptor, callback flags, table types and configuration role, but not compiled section containment. The installer directly indexes a row rather than scanning to the zero record; material creation receives a joint rather than a position.

Accept the four .sdata2 fact deferrals and .sdata2 link deferral. Literal arguments configure material hurt capsules, not an established ten-objective pool. Source does not establish pool size, ordering, exclusivity or compiled section membership.

Accept the four damage-callback supersessions. Canonical registration and dispatch support Material_DmgReceived, the symbolic small-quake argument and generic scenery feedback rather than objective-target destruction. Exact removal timing remains explicitly deferred.

Accept the remaining four supersessions correcting helper and translation-unit explanations. There are 40 candidates, not 41 successful placements. Joint pointers persist beyond initial position derivation, with nullable lookup and constructor failure branches. Ownership transfer and lifetime guarantees beyond the demonstrated later reads remain deferred.
